thread:
erin_s: Quick sync — Acme POC kickoff. Customer goal = agentic support assistant that can call the ticket API + retrieve across product docs. They want a 4-week POC, but legal/security questions and pricing are blockers. Need to lock success criteria, model choice (context length + function-calling), and a minimal timeline. Who can own each piece?

sanjay: High-level success metrics suggestion: recall@10 >= 85% on retrieval, reranker MRR > 0.6, end-to-end p95 latency < 700ms for L1 flows. Business metric: reduce average handle time by 20% on sampled queries. 4 weeks is doable if we scope week-by-week deliverables. :thumbsup:

marta: Model notes — recommend a model that supports function-calling + 32k context for long threads, but we can chunk as fallback. For embeddings: use redwood-embedding-2 for vector store. For rerank, prefer a lightweight cross-encoder reranker we host (better precision). Need evaluation prompts from the customer to baseline.

owen: Infra/cost quick ballpark: for ~1M docs embeddings + reranker we typically need 1 dedicated indexing job (cpu) + 2 GPUs for a production-grade reranker and 1 GPU for serving if they want low latency. Hosted token cost estimate versus dedicated commit: hosted likely higher per-token but faster setup; dedicated reduces compute unit cost ~30-45% depending on commit. I can produce a range with assumptions by Monday.

jade: Security checklist highlights from their draft: SAML SSO, SOC2 attestation, KMS/HSM for customer-managed keys, EU data residency, encrypted audit logs, and a question about model weights provenance and third-party telemetry. We should prepare written answers and a short architecture diagram showing Private vs Dedicated options. Also confirm retention defaults for POC data.

amanda: I'm coordinating ACME legal and procurement. They asked for a 2-week trial of Dedicated as a concession — can we propose a minimum deliverable for week 1 so they can validate value quickly? I'll secure their point of contact (Emily) and send over the security questionnaire.

marta: Proposed 4-week breakdown: Week 1 — ingest 100k docs, baseline embeddings + simple retrieval UI, smoke test tool-calling to sandbox ticket API. Week 2 — add cross-encoder reranker + rerank eval on customer queries. Week 3 — latency tuning (quantization + batching), cost optimizations and reserve commit options. Week 4 — business metrics, handoff, and runbook.

erin_s: Good. Action items: @marta prepare eval harness + sample prompt set and example reranker labels by EOD Friday; @owen provide cost band (hosted vs 1/3/6-month dedicated commit) by Monday; @jade draft security Q answers + KMS options and EU residency notes by Monday; @sanjay own consolidated POC plan doc & timeline; @amanda finalize trial ask with customer and share contact details.

sanjay: For function-calling we need the ticket API swagger and a small function signature. Example function schema for ticket lookup:```json
{"name":"get_ticket","parameters":{"type":"object","properties":{"ticket_id":{"type":"string"}},"required":["ticket_id"]}}
```We should send that to the customer to validate.

jade: Also flagged: they require proof of key rotation policy and export controls check. I'll draft short bullets for the questionnaire.

owen: One more: if they push for 32k context for retrieval+tooling we should highlight cost delta. I'll attach a sample cost calc once I have their QPS and average tokens per convo.

amanda: Customer wants a quick demo for stakeholders next Wednesday. Can we commit to ingest + retrieval UI by then?
marta: Yes if we scope ingest to a subset (100k docs) and a canned prompt set for the demo. We can do retrieval + simple tool-call mock.
erin_s: Closing notes — let's treat the trial as gated: concrete metrics for week 2 (recall + rerank numbers) to decide next steps. I'll send a short one-pager to Emily summarizing the plan and the asks (APIs, sample data, security questionnaire). :rocket:

security-bot: Reminder created: secure share /secure/acme-poc and security questionnaire template attached.

erin_s: Thanks all — I'll follow up with a calendar invite and link to the POC plan doc. If anyone has objections to owners/timeline, flag now.
